ai_summary.key_headline: Black Stars Target Dominant Midfield Presence Against Panama

ghana.philosophy: Fast vertical transition utilizing Kudus' ball-carrying ability.

panama.philosophy: Direct, physical CONCACAF football with an organized low block and set-piece focus.

tactical_insights: Mohammed Kudus' central ball-carrying will be the key to breaking Panama's organized defensive lines.
Panama will sit in a compact block and look to spring direct counters and set-pieces against the Black Stars.
Inaki Williams' diagonal runs in behind will be Ghana's primary attacking threat under Carlos Queiroz.
